news.title: DeepSeek Harness new Creator Mode creates plugins from prompts
news.summary: DeepSeek Harness has added a new Creator Mode, which aims to create plugins directly from text prompts.While AI models are capable of generating responses to prompts and determining a course of action, actually carrying it out requires a harness. Harnesses connect large language models (LLMs) to tools and systems that can perform actions, such as scheduling an appointment in a calendar or making a phone call. Put an AI model and a harness together, and you get an AI agent.DeepSeek's aptly named Harness is an open-source harness based around the idea that "everything is a plugin." Accordingly, Harness' new Creator Mode allows users to enter text prompts in order to generate new plugins. With message threads, agents no longer need to resend the full conversation history on every turn, reducing latency for long-running sessions.
